hook: Finnish golden eagles lost 82% of genome-wide heterozygosity in a bottleneck, despite recovering in number

readout.label: Drop in genome-wide heterozygosity, Finnish eagles

summary: Whole genomes from 26 Finnish golden eagles spanning 136 years show a steep loss of genetic variation after persecution drove numbers to a low in the 1950s and 1960s. Inbreeding signals rose even as the population grew back. The sample is small and from one country, and the effect on eagle health was not measured.
title: Genome-wide diversity across 130 years reveals drastic post-bottleneck genetic erosion in a recovering population of golden eagles (Aquila chrysaetos)
